scenes.heading: The Pythagorean theorem
scenes.narration: Welcome! Today we will learn the Pythagorean theorem. It tells us how the sides of a right triangle are related.

scenes.heading: The three sides
scenes.narration: A right triangle has one square corner and three sides. The two shorter sides are called a and b. The longest side, opposite the square corner, is called c, the hypotenuse.

scenes.heading: The rule
scenes.narration: The rule is simple. Square side a, square side b, and add them together. The result equals c squared.

scenes.heading: Example and recap
scenes.narration: Try a triangle with sides 3 and 4. Then 9 plus 16 is 25, so c is 5. Now you can find a missing side of any right triangle!
